_comment: Hand-edit this file to add APIs / nodes, then restart the relay.
Copy to upstreams.json (gitignored, holds your real keys).
This file WINS over ANTHROPIC_UPSTREAMS / OPENAI_UPSTREAMS in .env.
Flat pool format (v0.12): 'active' is a single name; all upstreams
share one pool regardless of which entry (/anthropic or /openai) the
traffic arrives on. Old per-platform layout auto-migrates on load.
Per-upstream keys:
name  (required, unique), url (required),
api_key (optional - relay substitutes it into the auth header),
auth_header (legacy; auth_style wins in v0.12+),
wire (optional - anthropic-messages | openai-chat | openai-responses,
auto-derived from url if omitted; drives cross-wire conversion),
endpoint (optional - explicit path for cross-wire),
auth_style (optional - bearer | x-api-key; wins over auth_header),
model / default_model / allowed_models (optional - model forcing/whitelist),
requires_anthropic_adapter (optional - true for dual-protocol gateways,
e.g. OpenCode Go: lowercase model + strip thinking + x-api-key),
thinking_options / token_fields / billing_unit (optional - GUI/accounting),
quota_5h / quota_week / quota_month / model_multipliers (optional - quotas),
note (optional - free text shown in the GUI).
'active' picks which one is used; the GUI writes it back here on switch.
